recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8).
2. Draw the content frame: a thin red (#CC0000) rectangular border framing the entire slide content, inset slightly from all four slide edges.
3. Place the title 'IRIS Dataset' centered horizontally in the top band of the slide (~5-15% height) in large, bold, red (#CC0000) sans-serif type.
4. Place the slide-number badge in the top-right corner: a yellow (#FFFF99) filled circle with a thin dark (#333333) outline, with the number '62' in black (#000000) centered inside.
5. Place the data table on the left half (~8-48% width, ~20-95% height), wrapped in its own thin red (#CC0000) border: a 6-column spreadsheet-style table with white (#FFFFFF) cell background, small monospace-like sans-serif text, and a header row in orange (#FF6600) reading 'Serial | sepal.length | sepal.width | petal.length | petal.width | Class'.
6. Fill the table with the 22 transcribed rows in 4 blocks, inserting one ellipsis row in each of the 3 gaps between blocks. Block 1, rows 1-8, Class 'Setosa': 1: 5.1, 3.5, 1.4, 0.2; 2: 4.9, 3, 1.4, 0.2; 3: 4.7, 3.2, 1.3, 0.2; 4: 4.6, 3.1, 1.5, 0.2; 5: 5, 3.6, 1.4, 0.2; 6: 5.4, 3.9, 1.7, 0.4; 7: 4.6, 3.4, 1.4, 0.3; 8: 5, 3.4, 1.5, 0.2. Block 2, rows 50-56 (inside the ~45-56 Setosa-to-Versicolor transition zone), Class 'Versicolor': 50: 7, 3.2, 4.7, 1.4; 51: 6.4, 3.2, 4.5, 1.5; 52: 6.9, 3.1, 4.9, 1.5; 53: 5.5, 2.3, 4, 1.3; 54: 6.5, 2.8, 4.6, 1.5; 55: 5.7, 2.8, 4.5, 1.3; 56: 6.3, 3.3, 4.7, 1.6. Block 3, rows 101-104 (inside the ~96-104 Versicolor-to-Virginica transition zone), Class 'Virginica': 101: 6.3, 3.3, 6, 2.5; 102: 5.8, 2.7, 5.1, 1.9; 103: 7.1, 3, 5.9, 2.1; 104: 6.3, 2.9, 5.6, 1.8. Block 4, final rows 148-150, Class 'Virginica': 148: 6.5, 3, 5.2, 2; 149: 6.2, 3.4, 5.4, 2.3; 150: 5.9, 3, 5.1, 1.8. Color every Class cell by class name: 'Setosa' red (#CC0000), 'Versicolor' green (#009900), 'Virginica' blue (#0000CC). Note [?]: the transition blocks are described as spanning rows ~45-56 and ~96-104, so rows ~45-49 and ~96-100 may also be visible but their values were not transcribed; numeric cells inside the two transition zones also appear color-tinted [?], exact cells unspecified.
7. Place the info box at right-center (~58-82% width, ~30-70% height): a white (#FFFFFF) rectangle with a thin blue/purple (#6666CC) border containing 9 lines in this order: '150 Samples' (bold blue #0000CC); blank line; '3 Classes' (bold blue #0000CC); 'Setosa' (red #CC0000); 'Versicolor' (green #009900); 'Virginica' (blue #0000CC); blank line; '4 Features' (bold blue #0000CC); 'No Direct Visualization' (red #CC0000, italic, underlined).
8. Optional screen-capture artifact (not slide content): place a small mouse-pointer arrow at ~60% width and ~72% height (lower-middle-right) on the gray background; arrow color unspecified [?].
